• Tuning system - a system that defines which pitches to use. Examples - Equal Temperament (Western music), Microtonal tuning system (Middle Eastern music)

• Interval - distance between 2 pitches.

• Octave - interval between a pitch and another pitch with double or half its frequency.

• Semitone - smallest distance between 2 pitches in Western music.
